attributes.name: Honaire
attributes.powers:
On your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or combat check, put this card on top of your deck to add 1d6 plus the scenario's adventure deck number and the Undead trait. 

Reveal this card to shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile into your deck, then discard this card.

When this card would leave your hand, if you do not have the Spiritualist trait, banish it instead.
